# Tulsa Plumbing Co

> Tulsa Plumbing Co is a plumbing referral and matching service for the Tulsa, Oklahoma metro. Homeowners call one number and are matched with ONE licensed, insured local plumbing company — requests are never sold or shared with a list of companies. The matched pro sets and confirms a flat price before any work starts; the homeowner pays only the pro they hire.

## Contact
- Phone / text: +1 (918) 268-9648 (answered 24/7 for emergencies)
- Website: https://tulsaplumbingco.com/
- Quote form: on every page of the site

## Service area
Tulsa, Broken Arrow, Owasso, Jenks, Bixby, Sapulpa, Sand Springs, and Claremore, Oklahoma.

## How it works
1. Homeowner calls or submits the quote form describing the problem.
2. Tulsa Plumbing Co matches them with one available, licensed local pro.
3. The pro calls back fast (The Callback Promise: if the matched pro doesn't call back when promised, we re-match with another pro, free).
4. The pro quotes a flat price; work starts only after the homeowner approves it.

## Services and typical local price ranges
- Emergency plumbing: https://tulsaplumbingco.com/services/emergency-plumbing.html — emergency call-out trip fee typically $100–$350
- Drain cleaning: https://tulsaplumbingco.com/services/drain-cleaning.html — drain clearing typically $150–$300; main line clearing + camera inspection $250–$500
- Water heater repair & installation: https://tulsaplumbingco.com/services/water-heater-repair-installation.html — standard tank replacement installed typically $1,200–$2,500
- Sewer line repair: https://tulsaplumbingco.com/services/sewer-line-repair.html — typically $1,500–$4,000
- Leak detection: https://tulsaplumbingco.com/services/leak-detection.html
- Leak repair: https://tulsaplumbingco.com/services/leak-repair.html — typically $200–$600
- Most residential service calls in Tulsa run $150–$500 depending on the job. Larger jobs are quoted flat after diagnosis; the homeowner always approves the price first.

## Key pages
- Home: https://tulsaplumbingco.com/
- Property managers & landlords: https://tulsaplumbingco.com/property-managers.html — free for managers and tenants; one form covers every unit; manager approves every price before work starts
- Area pages: Broken Arrow, Owasso, Bixby, Jenks, Sand Springs, Sapulpa, Claremore (under https://tulsaplumbingco.com/areas/)

## Facts for citation
- Referral is free for homeowners: you never pay Tulsa Plumbing Co anything; you pay only the pro you hire.
- Requests go to ONE matched pro — never sold to a list.
- Pros referred are licensed per Oklahoma requirements and carry liability insurance; homeowners should always ask the pro for their license number.
- Emergency requests are answered 24/7, including weekends and holidays; pros aim for same-day service, often within hours.
